name: io.github.Servosity/datagate-mcp
title: DataGate MCP
description: DataGate telecom billing lookups - customers, agreements, invoices, and more - for any MCP agent.

environmentVariables.name: DATAGATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from your DataGate account.

environmentVariables.name: DATAGATE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: ClientId GUID from your DataGate account. Required in addition to the Bearer token on every request.

environmentVariables.name: DATAGATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank to use DataGate's production endpoint (api.dgportal.net).

environmentVariables.name: DATAGATE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on DataGate requests.

environmentVariables.name: DATAGATE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the default client profile.
